grammars.name: c
grammars.definition:
# C: functions, structs, unions and enums (spec §5.3), through the C Grammar Helper (spec §7).
name       = "c"
extensions = ["c", "h"]
processor  = "treesitter"

[params]
grammar = "c"
query = '''
(function_definition
  declarator: [(function_declarator declarator: (identifier) @name)
               (pointer_declarator declarator: (function_declarator declarator: (identifier) @name))
               (pointer_declarator declarator: (pointer_declarator declarator: (function_declarator declarator: (identifier) @name)))]) @segment
(struct_specifier name: (type_identifier) @name body: (_)) @segment
(union_specifier name: (type_identifier) @name body: (_)) @segment
(enum_specifier name: (type_identifier) @name body: (_)) @segment
'''
kinds = { function_definition = "function", struct_specifier = "struct", union_specifier = "union", enum_specifier = "enum" }

grammars.name: c-sharp
grammars.definition:
# C#: namespaces, classes, structs, interfaces, enums, records, methods and constructors
# (spec §5.3), through the C# Grammar Helper (spec §7).
name       = "c-sharp"
extensions = ["cs"]
processor  = "treesitter"

[params]
grammar = "c-sharp"
query = '''
(namespace_declaration name: (_) @name) @segment
(file_scoped_namespace_declaration name: (_) @name) @segment
(class_declaration name: (identifier) @name) @segment
(struct_declaration name: (identifier) @name) @segment
(interface_declaration name: (identifier) @name) @segment
(enum_declaration name: (identifier) @name) @segment
(record_declaration name: (identifier) @name) @segment
(method_declaration name: (identifier) @name) @segment
(constructor_declaration name: (identifier) @name) @segment
'''
kinds = { namespace_declaration = "namespace", file_scoped_namespace_declaration = "namespace", class_declaration = "class", struct_declaration = "struct", interface_declaration = "interface", enum_declaration = "enum", record_declaration = "record", method_declaration = "method", constructor_declaration = "constructor" }

grammars.name: cpp
grammars.definition:
# C++: namespaces, classes, structs, enums, functions and methods (spec §5.3), through the C++
# Grammar Helper (spec §7).
name       = "cpp"
extensions = ["cpp", "cc", "cxx", "c++", "hpp", "hh", "hxx", "h++"]
processor  = "treesitter"

[params]
grammar = "cpp"
query = '''
(namespace_definition name: (_) @name) @segment
(class_specifier name: (_) @name body: (_)) @segment
(struct_specifier name: (_) @name body: (_)) @segment
(union_specifier name: (_) @name body: (_)) @segment
(enum_specifier name: (_) @name body: (_)) @segment
(function_definition
  declarator: [(function_declarator declarator: (_) @name)
               (pointer_declarator declarator: (function_declarator declarator: (_) @name))
               (reference_declarator (function_declarator declarator: (_) @name))]) @segment
'''
kinds = { namespace_definition = "namespace", class_specifier = "class", struct_specifier = "struct", union_specifier = "union", enum_specifier = "enum", function_definition = "function" }

grammars.name: elixir
grammars.definition:
# Elixir: modules, protocols and their functions and macros (spec §5.3), through the Elixir
# Grammar Helper (spec §7). Elixir's definitions are calls (`defmodule`, `def`), so the query
# keys on the called name and every Segment's kind is `definition`.
name       = "elixir"
extensions = ["ex", "exs"]
shebangs   = ["elixir"]
processor  = "treesitter"

[params]
grammar = "elixir"
query = '''
(call
  target: (identifier) @keyword
  (#any-of? @keyword "defmodule" "defprotocol" "defimpl")
  (arguments . (alias) @name)) @segment
(call
  target: (identifier) @keyword
  (#any-of? @keyword "def" "defp" "defmacro" "defmacrop" "defguard" "defguardp" "defdelegate")
  (arguments .
    [(identifier) @name
     (call target: (identifier) @name)
     (binary_operator left: (call target: (identifier) @name))
     (binary_operator left: (identifier) @name)])) @segment
'''
kinds = { call = "definition" }

grammars.name: java
grammars.definition:
# Java: classes, interfaces, enums, records, methods and constructors (spec §5.3), through the
# Java Grammar Helper (spec §7).
name       = "java"
extensions = ["java"]
processor  = "treesitter"

[params]
grammar = "java"
query = '''
(class_declaration name: (identifier) @name) @segment
(interface_declaration name: (identifier) @name) @segment
(enum_declaration name: (identifier) @name) @segment
(record_declaration name: (identifier) @name) @segment
(annotation_type_declaration name: (identifier) @name) @segment
(method_declaration name: (identifier) @name) @segment
(constructor_declaration name: (identifier) @name) @segment
'''
kinds = { class_declaration = "class", interface_declaration = "interface", enum_declaration = "enum", record_declaration = "record", annotation_type_declaration = "annotation", method_declaration = "method", constructor_declaration = "constructor" }

grammars.name: ruby
grammars.definition:
# Ruby: modules, classes and methods (spec §5.3), through the Ruby Grammar Helper (spec §7).
name       = "ruby"
extensions = ["rb", "rake", "gemspec"]
shebangs   = ["ruby"]
processor  = "treesitter"

[params]
grammar = "ruby"
query = '''
(module name: (_) @name) @segment
(class name: (_) @name) @segment
(singleton_class value: (_) @name) @segment
(method name: (_) @name) @segment
(singleton_method object: (_) @prefix name: (_) @name) @segment
'''
kinds = { module = "module", class = "class", singleton_class = "class", method = "method", singleton_method = "method" }
